{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness dynamic Cordis plugin: manage and delete conversation records (whole sessions or individual messages) from the web GUI.","id":"gh:1334447862","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-session-cleaner","slug":"haoranwang0921/dsh-session-cleaner","topics":["cordis-plugin","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","session-management"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness dynamic Cordis plugin: manage and delete conversation records (whole sessions or in"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"dividual messages) from the web GUI."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-session-cleaner"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 插件：在设置页中管理并删除对话记录。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 功能"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **删除整个会话**：归档会话并物理删除其持久化日志（JSONL 目录），同时清理该会话的消息反馈数据。

- **安全边界**：正在运行的会话与当前会话不可删除整会话；"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"只有 agent 真正在跑任务（mid-turn）的会话会被 Host 拒绝，空闲会话即使仍被宿主加载也不影响删除。单条消息删除仍拒绝任何 live 会话（Host 端校验），以保证与内存状态一致。"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 运行环境"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness Web GUI（`dsh web`）。"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## 安装（正式插件，随 DSH 启动自动加载）"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"本仓库是一个 **dual-face 插件包**：node half 运行在宿主进程（`/api/session-cleaner` 路由），browser half 通过 `dsh.client` 声"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"-face 插件包**：node half 运行在宿主进程（`/api/session-cleaner` 路由），browser half 通过 `dsh.client` 声明加载进 Web GUI。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"安装后插件随 DSH 启动自动加载，**无需每次重新安装**。使用入口：**设置 → 会话管理**。"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"更新代码后无需重新构建（本仓库为纯 JS），重启 `dsh web` 即可。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 工作原理"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`）向 profile 组合插入一行 `session-cleaner` 插件。
